title: 六年级
subtitle: 理想、文化、世界、情感、安全与小升初：综合表达与语篇

units.overview: 谈论未来理想和实现方式，综合运用将来时和不定式。

phonics.tip: scientist、teacher、doctor 结尾都是轻读音节，重音在前面。

words.ex_en: My dream is to be a doctor.
In the future I want to travel.
She wants to be an artist.
I want to become a teacher.
Keep trying and you will succeed.

patterns.en: I want to be a ... when I grow up.

examples.en: I want to be a scientist when I grow up.
examples.cn: 我长大后想成为科学家。

examples.en: She wants to be an English teacher.
examples.cn: 她想成为一名英语老师。

patterns.en: To reach my goal, I will ... .

examples.en: To reach my goal, I will study hard.
examples.cn: 为了实现目标，我会努力学习。

examples.en: I will practise speaking every day.
My dream is to help other people.
My dream is to visit many countries.
examples.cn: 我的梦想是去很多国家看看。

grammar.title: will 表示将来
grammar.explain: will + 动词原形表示将来要做的事或预测，否定为 will not（won't）。

examples.en: I will work hard this term.
It will be a great day.

grammar.title: want to be 与 want to do
grammar.explain: want to be + 职业（想成为）；want to do + 动作（想做某事）。

examples.en: I want to be a nurse.
I want to learn the guitar.

tips: 理想主题演讲结构：开头点题 + 两条理由 + 具体行动 + 结尾升华。

units.overview: 用英语介绍中国传统文化和深圳本地文化，学会被动语态入门。

phonics.tip: calligraphy /kəˈlɪɡrəfi/ 重音在第二音节，多音节词要按节奏读。

words.ex_en: Tea is part of our life.
words.ex_cn: 茶是我们生活的一部分。

words.ex_en: Paper is an old Chinese invention.
Our country has a long history.
The dragon is a symbol of China.

examples.en: The dragon is a symbol of China.
Tea is a symbol of hospitality.
It is made of silk.
These lanterns are made of paper.
Let me introduce Chinese tea to you.
Let me show you how to write my name.

grammar.title: 被动语态入门
grammar.explain: be + 过去分词表示「被……」：Paper was invented in China. 小学阶段重点掌握 is/are made of 和 was/were invented。

examples.en: Silk is made in China.
This song is sung by children.

grammar.title: 介绍事物的顺序
grammar.explain: 先说是什么（what），再说来自哪里（where），最后说为什么重要（why）。

examples.en: It is a kind of art from China. It shows our history.
examples.cn: 这是一种来自中国的艺术，它体现了我们的历史。

tips: 向外国朋友介绍深圳可以提：a young city、high technology、good food、the sea。

units.overview: 认识国家、首都和语言，比较不同国家的文化习惯。

phonics.tip: Australia /ɒˈstreɪliə/、Japan /dʒəˈpæn/ 的重音都不在第一个音节。

words.ex_en: Beijing is the capital of China.
Their food is different from ours.
words.ex_cn: 他们的食物和我们的不同。

words.ex_en: I have a pen friend in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我在加拿大有一个笔友。

examples.en: Where are you from?
I am from Shenzhen, China.
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
The capital of Australia is Canberra.
examples.cn: 澳大利亚的首都是堪培拉。

examples.en: Their breakfast is different from ours.
examples.cn: 他们的早餐和我们的不同。

examples.en: Winter there is colder than here.

grammar.title: be different from / be the same as
grammar.explain: 表示比较的固定搭配：A is different from B. / A is the same as B.

examples.en: My school is different from yours.
This book is the same as that one.

grammar.title: 国家、语言、人的说法
grammar.explain: China → Chinese（中国的/汉语/中国人），Japan → Japanese，Britain → British，America → American。

examples.en: She speaks Chinese and English.

tips: 写笔友信的格式：称呼 Dear ... , 正文, 结尾 Yours, 署名。

units.overview: 表达情绪、安慰同学、处理矛盾，学会 because / so 等连接词。

phonics.tip: nervous、famous 结尾的 ous 轻读为 /əs/。

words.ex_en: Do not be angry with him.
I am nervous before the exam.
We are excited about the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们对这次旅行很兴奋。

words.ex_en: She is worried about her test.
I am sorry for being late.

examples.en: How do you feel now?
I feel much better, thank you.
I feel nervous because I have a test.
examples.cn: 我很紧张，因为我要考试。

examples.en: She feels happy because she won.

patterns.en: Do not worry. I will help you.

examples.en: Do not worry. We can do it together.
examples.cn: 别担心，我们可以一起完成。

examples.en: Cheer up! You did your best.
examples.cn: 振作起来！你已经尽力了。

grammar.title: because 与 so
grammar.explain: because 引出原因，so 引出结果，一句话里不能同时用：Because it rained, we stayed at home. = It rained, so we stayed at home.

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

grammar.title: 形容词 -ed 和 -ing
grammar.explain: -ed 形容人的感受（I am excited），-ing 形容事物的特点（The game is exciting）。

examples.en: The story is interesting and I am interested in it.
examples.cn: 这个故事很有趣，我对它很感兴趣。

tips: 与同学产生矛盾时的表达：I am sorry. / It is OK. / Let us be friends again.

units.overview: 认识交通标志和安全规则，学会用祈使句和 must not 提醒他人。

phonics.tip: light、right、night 中的 igh 读 /aɪ/，gh 不发音。

words.ex_en: The traffic is heavy at five.
We practise fire escape at school.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校练习火灾逃生。

words.ex_en: Do not go with a stranger.
Wear a helmet when you ride.

examples.en: You must not cross on a red light.
You must not play near the road.
Always look both ways before crossing.
examples.cn: 过马路前一定要左右看。

examples.en: Always tell your parents before you go out.
examples.cn: 出门前一定要告诉父母。

examples.en: If there is a fire, leave quickly and call 119.
examples.cn: 如果发生火灾，迅速离开并拨打119。

examples.en: Do not use the lift in a fire.

grammar.title: 祈使句的肯定与否定
grammar.explain: 肯定直接用动词原形：Be careful.；否定用 Do not 开头：Do not run.

examples.en: Stop at the red light.
Do not touch the wires.

grammar.title: must not 表示禁止
grammar.explain: must not 语气比 should not 更强，表示「绝对不可以」。

examples.en: You must not swim alone.
examples.cn: 你绝对不可以独自游泳。

tips: 常用急救电话：110 police、119 fire、120 ambulance，练习说 Call 120, please!

units.overview: 回顾小学生活、准备升入初中，综合运用过去时、现在完成时和将来时。

phonics.tip: look at it 连读成 /lʊk ət ɪt/，口语中 to、of、and 常弱读。
examples: a lot of /ə lɒt əv/ 许多
used to /ˈjuːst tə/ 过去常常

words.ex_en: I will go to middle school in September.
The final exam is next week.
I revise my notes every evening.
I want to improve my writing.
I remember my first English lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我的第一节英语课。

words.ex_en: I am thankful to my teachers.
Middle school is a new challenge.

patterns.en: I have studied here for six years.

examples.en: I have studied English for six years.
We have been classmates since Grade One.
examples.cn: 我们从一年级起就是同学。

patterns.en: I used to ... , but now I ... .

examples.en: I used to be shy, but now I am confident.
examples.cn: 我以前很害羞，但现在很自信。

examples.en: I used to forget words, but now I keep a notebook.
examples.cn: 我以前记不住单词，现在我有单词本。

examples.en: In middle school I will join the English club.
examples.cn: 上中学后我要加入英语社。

examples.en: I will try my best in every subject.
examples.cn: 我会在每门功课上尽力。

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门
grammar.explain: have/has + 过去分词，表示到现在为止的经历或结果，常与 for、since、already、never 连用。

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has lived in Shenzhen since 2019.

grammar.title: used to do
grammar.explain: used to + 动词原形表示过去经常做而现在不做了。

examples.en: I used to play in this playground.
examples.cn: 我以前常在这个操场上玩。

tips: 毕业留言常用句：Best wishes! / Keep in touch! / I will never forget you.
